verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms that https://documentation.identity.entrust.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured summary of the platform. That file includes agent-usable content such as the applicant → workflow run → SDK capture → webhook/polling integration flow and the API v2→v3.6 migration guide. The docs are also served as raw .md pages, which an agent can ingest directly. Missing for 10: evidence of an llms-full.txt or explicitly agent/AI-oriented guidance pages, and independent hands-on reports of agents using these docs successfully.
